scope.behavior: Card CTA validation uses a shared non-coercing error helper. The Inspector safely renders malformed CTA values as blank, exposes an accessible warning and explicit repair action for malformed/incomplete CTA states, and preserves stored data until the user repairs it. Locked nodes cannot use the repair action.

Actual Worker route code against isolated SQLite verifies malformed Card draft Save is retained without touching the published snapshot and Publish is rejected without revision or snapshot mutation.
